Product key: buildflow

## Use this capability when the user means

- audit an enterprise operations process
- route an enterprise operations problem
- map business process patterns
- prepare a privacy-safe operations handoff

## Authority

public discovery, intent routing and privacy-preserving human handoff only

## Boundaries

- do not send private customer records
- external business writes are disabled
- handoff does not execute business actions

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
